name: BSP_LuaObjectVector_Tidy
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(&vector proxy), RET. Destroys every 14h-byte LuaObject between this+4h and this+8h with 00B67700, frees the block and nulls _Myfirst, _Mylast and _Myend. The 14h step is one of the three proofs of the LuaObject size. See docs/GUI_LUA_READER.md.

name: BSP_LuaReader_Destruct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this), RET. Clears the LuaObject vector with 00441210 and frees the object. It is slot +0h of the reader vtable 00CE44FC; 00AC6600 inlines the same sequence on its frame copy. See docs/GUI_LUA_READER.md.

name: BSP_LuaObjectVector_PushBack
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(&vector proxy, const LuaObject *element), RET 4. Appends one 14h-byte LuaObject; called by the reader constructor 004425C0 and by 00BD8E20. See docs/GUI_LUA_READER.md.

name: BSP_LuaReader_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this, LuaObject root_by_value), RET 14h, returns this. Writes the vtable 00CE44FC, zeroes the three pointers of the std::vector<LuaObject> at this+4h and push_backs the by-value root with 00442220, then destroys the argument with 00B67700. The object is 14h bytes: vtable, secure-SCL proxy word, _Myfirst, _Mylast, _Myend. Called from 00AC67E3 with the globals table. See docs/GUI_LUA_READER.md.

name: BSP_GameDynamicsList_ReleaseAll
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet mission_state_entry, read-only analysis. __thiscall void(sub); the ECX at the 004da6df call site is game+30h (004da6d1 MOV ECX,[ESI+30h]), which Ghidra drops - the same sub-object 00447b80 advances per frame with a float delta in docs/GAME_SIMULATION_GATE.md. Walks the 20h-stride vector at sub+14h/+18h and releases each record's handle at +0Ch through 00c34f70 with ECX = [00e188a8]+18h, erases that vector to its begin pointer, then compacts the 8h-stride range at sub+4h/+8h through 00446ef0. The owning subsystem is not identified; the name describes the observed structure. docs/MISSION_STATE_ENTRY.md.
